spectrostream_48khz_500k.pth.description: SpectroStream codec, 48 kHz, 64 RVQ levels, 500k steps (the paper uses the first 48 levels = 12 kbit/s)

bwe_spectrostream_multirate_25k.pth.description: Multi-rate BWE predictor on SpectroStream, 25k steps: 8/16/24/32 kHz, no rate conditioning (Table 1 'Ours (SpectroStream)')

bwe_dac_multirate_25k.pth.description: Multi-rate BWE predictor on DAC, 25k steps (Table 1 'Ours (DAC)')

dac_48khz_12cb.description: DAC codec retrained by us at 48 kHz with 12 codebooks, 44k steps (weights.pth + metadata.pth)
